body:
My cab entry says the sprayer trial workers brushed off waxy pollen.

The driver grew dizzy that afternoon, and the clover he had walked through was coated in the same wax.
title: Notebook page

body: A folded page inside the cab has the names of people assigned seats. Somebody crossed the whole column through and wrote “returned” above it. I saw the truck leave full. No one at the next road would say where its passengers had gone.
title: Handwritten letter
